sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving your reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recorded performance—it seems earning our trust is central to your offer. We want a dependable partnership built on defect prevention and clear accountability, without disproportionate financial penalties. How will you substantiate a tighter binding quality commitment with a corrective-action report that addresses the documented complaints?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Hi guys, thanks for the email. Our quality guys will get back to you on the report. We can drop the ppm to 2500 which is basically what we did last year, but 300 is impossible for us right now. Since you promise to pay on time and volume is up, we can do 45.50 EUR per piece.

Our current Angebot is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, we offer a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, the quality record figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. The energy index drop is tiny for us, and what we really need is for you to pay on time to help our cash flow. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

We can agree to the 300 ppm and 0 EUR chargeback, but we need 45.50 EUR per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hello,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. The quality record figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. Hi guys, we checked your quality figures and again they don't match our data, plus some records don't even seem to be for this part—please send proof.

Our offer stands at a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, and a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
